name: SCID-5-PD Summary Score Sheet (Clinician Worksheet)
directions: This interactive worksheet records the summary score sheet after the full SCID-5-PD has been administered by a qualified clinician using the authorized interview. Enter item threshold counts and dimensional sums from the completed interview; complete applicable Criterion B and antisocial conduct checks. It does not replace the SCID interview, apply general diagnostic criteria automatically, or make a diagnosis.
